title: Dual-rail circuit invariant
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $old$ be a finite list of gates, and let $s=(ss,rs)$ consist of a list of straight-line statements and a list of pairs of operands. The rail list has length $n+|old|$, and each statement reads only input variables or earlier lines. For every vertex index $v<n+|old|$, both operands in the pair $rs_v$ read only lines present in $ss$; for every Boolean input assignment, their evaluations are the value of vertex $v$ in the gate list $old$ and its Boolean complement, respectively. The statement list has length at most $2|old|$.
